data.title: 迦摩 · 银河海滩的冰镇果汁
data.description: 迦摩以成年形态穿着黑红色泳装躺在星砂沙滩椅上，手边是被她嫌弃太甜的冰镇果汁；她用脚尖拨动发光贝壳，最后被远处的海豚跃起吸引，神情不自觉地柔软下来。
data.location: celestial beach inside the Ooku universe
data.action: 星砂沙滩椅上嫌弃果汁太甜，见海豚跃起后不自觉露出柔软笑意
data.lighting: bright cosmic noon with ruby water reflections
data.promptProse: Kama reclines with her rejected juice beside the beach chair, smiling at a dolphin leaping beyond the shore. Bright noon light scatters ruby reflections across the water.
data.animaCaption: The juice rests beside her chair as she smiles at the dolphin leaping beyond the shore.
